name: Fee or tax payment demanded to release funds
description: Payments are made as fees or taxes supposedly needed to release a prize, loan, inheritance or gains.
fp: Genuine release fees exist but are rare and verifiable.

links.name: Payments for fees to release prize, loan or inheritance
links.ctx: Victim-side: repeated small payments for taxes, fees or insurance.

links.name: Large 'withdrawal fee' or 'tax' payment to release gains
links.ctx: Victim-side: after a seemingly profitable period, the customer sends further funds to unlock profits.
